reason: As someone burned by the first campaign and short on spare cash, A answers my doubts directly: it names the Majestic, shows only $49,000 is left after the bank and written business pledges, firmly guarantees full refunds, admits the roof and film-booking risks, and promises public spending reports. B is full of unfilled placeholders, asks for more ($60,000), and leaves the refund promise in brackets, which reads unfinished and less trustworthy.
